ontology_metadata.name: Healthcare World Model Architecture and Evidence Ontology
ontology_metadata.status: Proposed research ontology and evidence-coding specification; not a clinically validated system or consensus standard
ontology_metadata.purpose: Fit heterogeneous healthcare papers to qualified architectural assertions, then derive context-specific blueprints with traceable design choices, evidence gaps and release gates.
ontology_metadata.scope: All paper strata, world scales, architectures, component studies, evaluation/audit studies and research/deployment contexts; the current corpus has 211 records.
ontology_metadata.format: Plain JSON ontology specification with an embedded JSON Schema for annotation records. Logical classification rules are explicitly specified, not claimed to be an OWL or SHACL implementation.

source_resolution_log.resolution: Use the JSON schema: matched alternative-action prediction comparisons qualify functionally as L3, including one-step comparisons. Identified causal effects are a separate claim requiring additional evidence.
Not reported in this extraction may mean paper silence or incomplete extraction. Neither implies an absent mechanism; count bounds and unknown categories separately.
FS/FT/FU are templated reviewer mappings. They may inform a design recommendation but cannot establish that a paper implements M1–M10 or create independent corroboration.
p_step_naive and p_step_blueprint are hard-coded arrays. Their products and plotted reliability gains are illustrations, not measured end-to-end safety or causal reliability.

The dry run uses hand-written dynamics, a fixed horizon, a constructed support function and an unconditional personalized_p3_verified flag. It does not train JEPA, run EndoClock, estimate propensity, prove personalization, calibrate clinical intervals or validate all failure traps.

The notebook S1 uses delta-time OR missingness; S3 uses rollout AND drift; S4 uses stochasticity AND a calibration entry; S5 uses assumptions OR a support check. These proxies are not full data-contract, effective-horizon, uncertainty-decomposition or causal-identification validation. New gates below use stronger explicit requirements.
Phantom/animal/bench control is not R6 patient feasibility. R4 reader review does not imply external validation. Preserve all evidence facets; legacy highest R is only a scoped display summary.

Latent, JEPA, RSSM, mechanistic priors and multi-step losses are options with trade-offs, not universal membership conditions. A frozen encoder or deterministic physical model is not automatically defective.
A nonsignificant association test is not proof of statistical independence. Treat capability and readiness as conceptually separate axes without encoding empirical independence as an axiom.

Shared authors, data, model lineage and exact duplication are distinct dependency relations. Graph connected components neither prove 91 independent studies nor establish causal dependence among all member results.
Counts and exploratory communities measure this extraction, not necessity, safety or universal architectural suitability; do not rank safety or causality by graph centrality or summed ordinal scores.
A stated maximum or hard-coded clamp is not an empirically validated horizon. Store metric, tolerance, horizon curve, cohort, action support, confidence and model version.
L2/L3/L4 do not correspond one-to-one to Pearl rungs. Action conditioning, mechanism priors and trial-effect agreement do not alone establish identification or individual counterfactual truth.
Action role and effect channel are separate. Probe motion or diagnostic sampling can change observations and exert contact, tissue or downstream-care effects; permit mixed channels.

Do not universally ban single-parameter changes or hard-code one ventilator field set. Require the context-specific bundle/update semantics and empirical/clinical support; partial updates can legitimately inherit unchanged validated settings.

The ontology supplies no universal dose, force, latency, uncertainty, horizon or propensity threshold. Thresholds require an intended-use-specific protocol, units, source, validation and responsible approval.

Epistemic and aleatoric uncertainty can both affect risk decisions. Separate them where identifiable; neither stochastic samples nor a normal confidence band demonstrates a valid decomposition or calibration.

Do not inherit narrative metadata slips: HealthFormer B099 is not the 150M/118M Epic Curiosity cohort, and TE in B096 is treatment-effect estimation, not proof of transfer-entropy causal discovery. Verify each acronym/cohort in the actual paper.

Naming a framework, ethical approval and compliance/clearance are distinct. Framework relevance and legal obligations depend on jurisdiction, intended use and date; this ontology does not determine legal compliance.
Use value-witnessed, cell-witnessed, sub-cell-witnessed, external-witness-only and unresolved, scoped to the target/grid; notebook synonyms are not copied.
Narrative graph counts and the saved graph artifact differ. Pin hashes/snapshots and do not treat narrative counts or graph centrality as stable evidence or validated ontology structure.

epistemic_policy.world_assumption: Open world for research facts; closed-world completeness checks are allowed only inside an explicitly declared annotation or release contract.

assessment_states.present: Positive, scope-matched evidence meets the feature criteria at the recorded evidence stage.
assessment_states.absent: Explicit scope-matched negative evidence or a completely documented incompatible mechanism establishes non-use. Silence, failed text search and a blank cell never suffice.
assessment_states.partial: A defined subset of the criteria is met; record satisfied and missing parts. Not a fallback for vague evidence.
assessment_states.not_reported: Relevant sources were inspected but the feature was not reported/captured sufficiently; paper silence and extraction-limited silence must be distinguished by reason.
assessment_states.not_assessed: No sufficient inspection of the applicable source/feature has been completed, including unavailable full text.
assessment_states.unknown: Inspected information remains insufficient or ambiguous despite being relevant; record what would resolve it.
assessment_states.not_applicable: An explicit scope or dependency makes the question inapplicable; provide the applicability reason, not simply a negative answer.
assessment_states.conflicting: Compatible-scope evidence supports incompatible states/values. Retain both assertions, do not majority-vote them away.

evidence_stages.specification: Operational method/algorithm/equation described, but execution not established.
evidence_stages.implementation: Executed method or released operational code path is documented; not necessarily effective.
evidence_stages.evaluation: A scope-matched experiment/analysis of the feature has reported results, including negative results.
evidence_stages.replication: An independent execution/evaluation under documented conditions is reported.

non_entailments: present at claim does not entail present at implementation or evaluation
evaluation performed does not entail successful validation
implementation absent is not derived from an unreported evaluation
quote located does not entail interpretation verified; quote not located does not entail false
model family, self-label, architecture depth, publication venue and corpus popularity do not establish capability, causal validity or readiness
L4 does not entail that a separate L3 comparison experiment, closed-loop replanning, human evaluation or causal identification was performed
a prediction distribution does not establish epistemic/aleatoric separation or calibration
module informs_blueprint does not entail module implemented_by_model
regulatory mention does not entail applicable requirement, compliance, clearance or approval
prospective data collection does not entail prospective model deployment
zero observed failures in a finite test does not entail safety
a general interface signature does not establish compatible units, state semantics, populations or validated composition
precedence: Per-field legacy schema for migration semantics
Version-pinned primary evidence for paper facts
This ontology definitions for new qualified annotations
absence_requirements: Specify what is absent: design mechanism, implemented feature, evaluation, or successful validation.
Cite the explicit negative passage or a fully inspected incompatible algorithm/configuration.
Resolve version, module and context differences before declaring a conflict.

aggregation.state_counts: Report present, absent, partial, unresolved, not assessed and not applicable separately.
aggregation.denominator: Publish record and dependency-adjusted study counts, applicable denominator, source version and unresolved share.
aggregation.evidence_unit: Independent study/evaluation, not repeated paper versions, templated reviewer sentences or duplicate cohorts.
aggregation.numeric_comparison: Require task, metric definition, units, horizon, cohort/split, baseline, direction and uncertainty; never pool heterogeneous headline percentages.

threshold_policy.default_if_missing: Gate status unresolved or not_ready; never invent a numerical clinical threshold.

classes.label: Research entity
classes.definition: Versioned research/design/evidence object.
classes.consider_as_this_when: An identifiable source or specification is represented.
classes.do_not_consider_as_this_when: An unqualified free-text keyword is mistaken for a verified implementation.

classes.label: Paper record
classes.definition: Bibliographic record, independent of number of models or experiments.
classes.consider_as_this_when: A distinct article/report/version is catalogued.
classes.do_not_consider_as_this_when: Treating one paper as exactly one model, study, or independent validation.

classes.label: Paper version
classes.definition: Exact read document version with date/hash.
classes.consider_as_this_when: A PDF, accepted manuscript or dated preprint version is pinned.
classes.do_not_consider_as_this_when: A filename year alone or an unspecified evolving URL.

classes.label: Study
classes.definition: An investigation with a defined design, population and analyses.
classes.consider_as_this_when: Methods define an empirical or formal investigation.
classes.do_not_consider_as_this_when: A citation, abstract claim or repeated version is counted as a new study.

classes.label: Study lineage
classes.definition: Explicit related-study group with typed dependence edges.
classes.consider_as_this_when: Extension, shared-model, shared-data or duplicate evidence is documented.
classes.do_not_consider_as_this_when: Same author or graph neighborhood alone certifies dependency or independence.

classes.label: Model version
classes.definition: Specified trained/parameterized predictive artifact and configuration.
classes.consider_as_this_when: Architecture, weights/parameters, configuration or training run identify a version.
classes.do_not_consider_as_this_when: A family label such as diffusion is treated as one model instance.

classes.label: System composition
classes.definition: Wiring of model and non-model components.
classes.consider_as_this_when: Data/control dependencies and compatible interfaces are specified.
classes.do_not_consider_as_this_when: A set of papers merely co-mentions modules.

classes.label: Module implementation
classes.definition: Concrete component realizing one or more blueprint responsibilities.
classes.consider_as_this_when: Operational inputs/outputs and executed responsibilities are evidenced.
classes.do_not_consider_as_this_when: A module name, recommendation or reviewer FS tag only.

classes.label: Interface contract
classes.definition: Typed and semantic boundary between components.
classes.consider_as_this_when: Input/output, units, time, uncertainty, version and errors are specified.
classes.do_not_consider_as_this_when: A function signature alone is called compatible or validated.

classes.label: World type
classes.definition: Nature of the evolving entity/problem, separate from specialty.
classes.consider_as_this_when: The entity whose state evolves and its interaction context are identified.
classes.do_not_consider_as_this_when: Specialty or input modality alone determines a world type.

classes.label: Intended-use context
classes.definition: Population, user, setting, purpose and decision boundary.
classes.consider_as_this_when: A scoped research/deployment use is documented.
classes.do_not_consider_as_this_when: A generic healthcare label substitutes for intended use.

classes.label: State specification
classes.definition: Variables or representation carried between prediction/update steps.
classes.consider_as_this_when: A persistent explicit/latent state with update/transition semantics is defined.
classes.do_not_consider_as_this_when: A static label or one-off embedding automatically implies temporal dynamics.

classes.label: Action specification
classes.definition: A controllable input with role, target, timing and effect channels.
classes.consider_as_this_when: An intervention/command can be set or queried in the model.
classes.do_not_consider_as_this_when: An outcome label, disease onset or post-treatment covariate is silently treated as an executable intervention.

classes.label: Action regime
classes.definition: Time-indexed action sequence or policy defining intervention alternatives.
classes.consider_as_this_when: Agent, dose/parameters, timing, route and co-interventions are specified where applicable.
classes.do_not_consider_as_this_when: A drug name without enough context is called a complete regimen.

classes.label: Observation specification
classes.definition: Measurement/event with acquisition and availability context.
classes.consider_as_this_when: What was measured and when it became available are recorded.
classes.do_not_consider_as_this_when: An unmeasured value or future information is treated as observed input.

classes.label: Time specification
classes.definition: Clock, timestamp, step/event indexing and temporal support.
classes.consider_as_this_when: Step size or event-time semantics and units are declared.
classes.do_not_consider_as_this_when: Diffusion denoising time is confused with physical/patient time.

classes.label: Dynamics specification
classes.definition: Transition operator over declared world states.
classes.consider_as_this_when: Next/future state depends on present/history and temporal or acquisition displacement.
classes.do_not_consider_as_this_when: A static classifier or image reconstruction without evolving-state semantics.

classes.label: Outcome specification
classes.definition: Typed future-state readout or trajectory endpoint.
classes.consider_as_this_when: Target, horizon, units and measurement are defined.
classes.do_not_consider_as_this_when: A decoder, utility or causal effect is conflated with every outcome.

classes.label: Causal estimand
classes.definition: Explicit intervention-effect target in a specified population.
classes.consider_as_this_when: Intervention alternatives, outcomes, times and contrast are declared.
classes.do_not_consider_as_this_when: An action-conditioned prediction or anatomical plausibility alone.

classes.label: Causal assumption
classes.definition: Condition needed by a specified identification strategy.
classes.consider_as_this_when: A named assumption is connected to the estimand and design.
classes.do_not_consider_as_this_when: Assumption naming is treated as empirical proof it holds.

classes.label: Dataset version
classes.definition: Versioned clinical/synthetic data resource with access/provenance.
classes.consider_as_this_when: Data release or institution/time snapshot is identifiable.
classes.do_not_consider_as_this_when: A dataset family string is counted as a unique cohort or independent test.

classes.label: Cohort
classes.definition: Defined sample and eligibility criteria within a data resource.
classes.consider_as_this_when: Population, sampling, count units and inclusion/exclusion are described.
classes.do_not_consider_as_this_when: Scans, stays, events and patients are equated or counts added without overlap checks.

classes.label: Evaluation protocol
classes.definition: Prespecified or explicitly described test procedure.
classes.consider_as_this_when: Task, splits, metrics, tolerances, analysis and comparator are identifiable.
classes.do_not_consider_as_this_when: A metric name or plot alone is called a complete protocol.

classes.label: Evaluation run
classes.definition: A particular evaluated model/system under a protocol.
classes.consider_as_this_when: Model version, cohort, horizon/action context and measured results are connected.
classes.do_not_consider_as_this_when: Results from one module/context are assigned to the complete system.

classes.label: Metric result
classes.definition: Qualified quantitative result.
classes.consider_as_this_when: Value, units/scale, direction, task, split, horizon and baseline where comparative are supplied.
classes.do_not_consider_as_this_when: Bare percent improvement or AUROC without outcome/context is pooled as performance.

classes.label: Evidence fragment
classes.definition: Version-pinned source passage/table/code segment.
classes.consider_as_this_when: Source version plus locator, content and review status are available.
classes.do_not_consider_as_this_when: Only a page number, generated summary or located substring without entailment review.

classes.label: Qualified assertion
classes.definition: A subject-property-value statement with stage, status and evidence.
classes.consider_as_this_when: Subject/version, scope, evidence basis and assessment state are explicit.
classes.do_not_consider_as_this_when: An unqualified paper-to-category edge is called verified implementation.

classes.label: Author claim
classes.definition: Statement the authors make, possibly exceeding evidence.
classes.consider_as_this_when: The source explicitly claims an architecture/capability/effect.
classes.do_not_consider_as_this_when: Reviewer synthesis or a result extrapolation is attributed to authors.

classes.label: Design requirement
classes.definition: Context-conditioned proposed obligation.
classes.consider_as_this_when: Applicability, rationale, pass evidence and exceptions are declared.
classes.do_not_consider_as_this_when: A frequent pattern is declared mandatory for every world model.

classes.label: Evidence gate
classes.definition: A decision on sufficiency of evidence for a declared purpose.
classes.consider_as_this_when: Required assertions and contextual validation criteria can be checked.
classes.do_not_consider_as_this_when: Missing evidence is called an implemented-feature failure.

classes.label: Failure mode
classes.definition: Defined mechanism of invalid/unsafe behavior.
classes.consider_as_this_when: An observed event/test matches the failure definition.
classes.do_not_consider_as_this_when: Potential hazard or absence of a mitigation is counted as an observed failure.

classes.label: Mitigation
classes.definition: Intervention intended to reduce a specified failure risk.
classes.consider_as_this_when: A mechanism is connected to a failure and implementation/effectiveness evidence are distinguished.
classes.do_not_consider_as_this_when: A safety term or policy document proves risk elimination.

classes.label: Blueprint profile
classes.definition: Composable world/use-specific architecture recipe.
classes.consider_as_this_when: Modules, optional choices, contracts and evidence gates are explicitly connected.
classes.do_not_consider_as_this_when: A discovered cluster or specialty dictates a universally optimal design.

classes.label: Design decision
classes.definition: Trade-off selection with alternatives and rationale.
classes.consider_as_this_when: Context, alternatives, justification and evidence are documented.
classes.do_not_consider_as_this_when: Popularity or reviewer score alone proves the chosen design is superior.

classes.label: Deployment
classes.definition: A model/system made available in an operational environment.
classes.consider_as_this_when: Environment, users, effect on care and release/version are known.
classes.do_not_consider_as_this_when: Offline dataset evaluation, bench robot or demo is called clinical deployment.

classes.label: Human evaluation study
classes.definition: Actual human participants reviewing or using model outputs.
classes.consider_as_this_when: Human roles, task, sample/ratings and outcomes are documented.
classes.do_not_consider_as_this_when: An LLM, automated scorer, or simulated clinician feedback alone.

classes.label: Calibration report
classes.definition: Uncertainty validation with target coverage/reliability context.
classes.consider_as_this_when: Calibration metric, nominal target, observed result, split and horizon are specified.
classes.do_not_consider_as_this_when: Stochastic generation, accuracy, interval width or nominal confidence alone.

classes.label: Effective horizon
classes.definition: Empirically supported forecast/planning extent at stated tolerances.
classes.consider_as_this_when: Model, metric/tolerance, action support, population and horizon evidence are linked.
classes.do_not_consider_as_this_when: Maximum generated length, computational horizon, hard-coded demo clamp or a plot without tolerance.

classes.label: Governance applicability assessment
classes.definition: Jurisdiction/use-specific relevance of a standard or legal framework.
classes.consider_as_this_when: Named framework/version, jurisdiction, intended use and documented assessment exist.
classes.do_not_consider_as_this_when: Framework mention, ethics approval or licensing alone proves applicability/compliance.

classes.label: Model/system card
classes.definition: Structured report of intended use, limits, assets and validation.
classes.consider_as_this_when: Version and evidence-backed capabilities, failure limits and monitoring are documented.
classes.do_not_consider_as_this_when: An abstract or architecture diagram alone.

classes.label: Exploratory analysis finding
classes.definition: Notebook-derived statistic, pattern or hypothesis.
classes.consider_as_this_when: Data snapshot, code cell, assumptions and uncertainty/proxy limits are attached.
classes.do_not_consider_as_this_when: A notebook correlation, graph hub or manually assigned array is promoted to primary clinical evidence.

classes.label: Blueprint module
classes.definition: A reusable responsibility definition M1–M10, distinct from its implementation.
classes.consider_as_this_when: An ontology definition/facet is explicitly identified.
classes.do_not_consider_as_this_when: An actual implementation or study result is silently equated with its abstract class.

classes.label: Feature definition
classes.definition: An operational coding criterion in the feature catalogue.
classes.consider_as_this_when: An ontology definition/facet is explicitly identified.
classes.do_not_consider_as_this_when: An actual implementation or study result is silently equated with its abstract class.

classes.label: Capability label
classes.definition: A functional evidence summary L0–L4 or not-world-model; not clinical or causal assurance.
classes.consider_as_this_when: An ontology definition/facet is explicitly identified.
classes.do_not_consider_as_this_when: An actual implementation or study result is silently equated with its abstract class.

classes.label: Readiness evidence facet
classes.definition: An independently scoped clinical/technical validation form, not a cumulative quality score.
classes.consider_as_this_when: An ontology definition/facet is explicitly identified.
classes.do_not_consider_as_this_when: An actual implementation or study result is silently equated with its abstract class.

interface_contracts.name: ObservationPacket
invariants: Unmeasured is distinguishable from true zero.
No input is available earlier than its information-release time.
A regular grid is allowed only with declared assumptions/audit and retained timing witnesses appropriate to the task.

interface_contracts.name: StateSnapshot / BeliefDistribution
conditional: prior/posterior designation if a belief filter
invariants: No silent change of variable order/coordinate frames across observations.
Identity/time lineage persists through assimilation and prediction.
Updating state is distinguishable from updating weights.

interface_contracts.name: ActionSchedule
conditional: pose frame and actuator mapping for physical commands
permission and reversibility for external effects
invariants: No future factual outcome is used to construct a candidate at decision time.
Omitted bundle fields are explicitly unknown or inherited, never silently reset.
Unsupported action is flagged before downstream causal interpretation/execution.

interface_contracts.name: TransitionPrediction
invariants: Patient time, acquisition pose and diffusion sampling time are not interchangeable.
A predictive association is labeled as such.

interface_contracts.name: TrajectoryDistribution
invariants: Teacher-forced, free-running, block-generated and re-assimilated predictions are distinguished.
No silent horizon clamp.
Joint-path coverage is not inferred from marginal intervals.

interface_contracts.name: Outcome / EffectAssessment
conditional: estimand, intervention alternatives, assumptions, identification and support for causal-effect interpretation
invariants: Raw prediction, diagnostic surrogate, utility and patient benefit are separate types.

interface_contracts.name: PlanProposal
invariants: Proposal is not an authorization to execute.
Evaluate optimized plans under independent/mismatched conditions before claiming exploitation resistance.

interface_contracts.name: SafetyDecision
invariants: Unknown safety-critical evidence does not silently default to allow.
Eligibility for review is not proof of safety.
Authorization is use- and actor-specific.

interface_contracts.name: Evidence and release dossier
invariants: A new composition needs composition-level validation.
No claims are inherited from another use, model version or source cohort without transfer evidence.

design_axes.question: What is predicted and retained?
design_axes.classification_rule: Classify the actual propagated state; distinguish input, internal state and decoded output. Multiple options require explicit mappings.

design_axes.question: What uncertainty is represented and tested?
design_axes.classification_rule: Record mechanism separately from empirical calibration; sampling alone establishes neither posterior correctness nor calibration.

design_axes.question: How does relevant history persist?
design_axes.classification_rule: Require a stated update/read mechanism and effective history scope; sequence length is not evidence of useful long-term memory.

design_axes.question: Which inductive constraints are operative?
design_axes.classification_rule: A named prior must constrain computation or training; a causal diagram in discussion does not establish an identified causal simulator.

design_axes.question: How are predictions used?
design_axes.classification_rule: Assign from demonstrated use with scope and environment; a proposed planner remains specification-stage.

failure_modes.label: Compounding rollout drift
failure_modes.consider_occurrence_present_when: Free-running state/observation error or validity violations grow with successive modeled transitions under a fixed protocol.
failure_modes.do_not_count_as_observed_failure_when: Only a potential hazard, unreported mitigation, reviewer warning or untested hypothetical is described.
failure_modes.bounded_negative_result: A specified test may report zero observed events; record sample/exposure and uncertainty. This is not universal absence of the hazard.
failure_modes.mitigation_effectiveness: Presence of a mitigation is separate from demonstrated reduction of this failure.

failure_modes.label: Planner exploitation
failure_modes.consider_occurrence_present_when: Optimized actions achieve favorable model scores but degrade independent/real/reference outcomes or exploit demonstrable model/reward errors.

extraction_crosswalk.legacy_definition: Local ID (001–099, B001–B106, A01–A20) or new ID
extraction_crosswalk.legacy_fill_only_if: Always fill. Use the local file prefix (001–099, B001–B106, A01–A20); new papers get the next free ID.
extraction_crosswalk.import_policy: Preserve raw cell, workbook hash, row, column and extraction metadata. Create provisional candidate annotations, not new verified paper facts.
extraction_crosswalk.scope_policy: Attach to model/evaluation/module/use context where known; unresolved paper-to-model attribution must stay unresolved.
extraction_crosswalk.if_not_reported: not_reported with missingness_reason=legacy_silence_or_extraction_depth_undetermined unless primary-source inspection resolves the reason

competency_questions.question: Which papers implement a simulator for a specified world and intended use?
competency_questions.answer_rule: Match world type and use context; require implementation-stage present dynamics assertions; separate conceptual recommendations.
competency_questions.missing_answer_policy: Return unresolved with evidence gaps, never a fabricated negative.

competency_questions.question: Which modules are implemented versus merely recommended?
competency_questions.answer_rule: Traverse implements/evaluates/recommends with qualified evidence; never convert FS/FT/FU into implementation.
competency_questions.missing_answer_policy: Return unresolved with evidence gaps, never a fabricated negative.

competency_questions.question: What is the input-state-action-time-output contract?
competency_questions.answer_rule: Join M1–M7 contracts for the same model version; return unresolved fields explicitly.
competency_questions.missing_answer_policy: Return unresolved with evidence gaps, never a fabricated negative.

competency_questions.question: Which action types change physiology, acquisition, information or workflow?
competency_questions.answer_rule: Match orthogonal action effect channels, roles and authority; allow overlap.
competency_questions.missing_answer_policy: Return unresolved with evidence gaps, never a fabricated negative.

competency_questions.question: Can a system compare treatment alternatives without established causal identification?
competency_questions.answer_rule: Select functional L3 and inspect independent causal estimand/assumption/support assertions; do not infer identified effects.
competency_questions.missing_answer_policy: Return unresolved with evidence gaps, never a fabricated negative.

competency_questions.question: Where has closed-loop control actually been tested?
competency_questions.answer_rule: Select evaluated control assertions and environment kind; distinguish in-silico, phantom, animal and patient evidence.
competency_questions.missing_answer_policy: Return unresolved with evidence gaps, never a fabricated negative.

competency_questions.question: Which uncertainty methods passed trajectory calibration?
competency_questions.answer_rule: Require calibration evaluation present, test outcome pass, declared metric/tolerance/horizon/cohort and relevant uncertainty scope.
competency_questions.missing_answer_policy: Return unresolved with evidence gaps, never a fabricated negative.

competency_questions.question: What is the defensible effective rollout horizon?
competency_questions.answer_rule: Use error/risk-versus-horizon evaluation and declared acceptability criterion; return unresolved if only maximum generated length is reported.
competency_questions.missing_answer_policy: Return unresolved with evidence gaps, never a fabricated negative.

competency_questions.question: Which results share data, models or studies?
competency_questions.answer_rule: Traverse typed lineage and dependency relations; do not equate author overlap or graph components with independent trials.
competency_questions.missing_answer_policy: Return unresolved with evidence gaps, never a fabricated negative.

competency_questions.question: Which safety mitigations have evidence of effectiveness?
competency_questions.answer_rule: Join failure occurrence, implemented mitigation and evaluated mitigation result; absence of reported incidents is not absence of hazard.
competency_questions.missing_answer_policy: Return unresolved with evidence gaps, never a fabricated negative.

competency_questions.question: Which requirements are unmet, untested or inapplicable?
competency_questions.answer_rule: Select applicable profile gates; distinguish fail, unresolved and documented not_applicable rather than summing scores.
competency_questions.missing_answer_policy: Return unresolved with evidence gaps, never a fabricated negative.

competency_questions.question: Which modules can be reused together?
competency_questions.answer_rule: Compare units, state meaning, action semantics, time conventions, support, uncertainty and versions; require composition-level evaluation.
competency_questions.missing_answer_policy: Return unresolved with evidence gaps, never a fabricated negative.

competency_questions.question: Which papers have human workflow review but no prospective patient control?
competency_questions.answer_rule: Query readiness facets and environment independently; a reader study is not patient feasibility.
competency_questions.missing_answer_policy: Return unresolved with evidence gaps, never a fabricated negative.

competency_questions.question: What evidence supports personalization?
competency_questions.answer_rule: Require person-specific adaptation/conditioning mechanism and appropriately separated individual-level evaluation; pooled accuracy alone is insufficient.
competency_questions.missing_answer_policy: Return unresolved with evidence gaps, never a fabricated negative.

competency_questions.question: Which architectural gaps are real absence versus missing extraction?
competency_questions.answer_rule: Group feature assessments by all eight epistemic states and evidence stage; retain missingness reason.
competency_questions.missing_answer_policy: Return unresolved with evidence gaps, never a fabricated negative.

competency_questions.question: What architecture fits a new specialty/use case?
competency_questions.answer_rule: Select world, context, archetype and profile; instantiate applicable requirements, alternatives and evidence gaps rather than choosing the most frequent backbone.
competency_questions.missing_answer_policy: Return unresolved with evidence gaps, never a fabricated negative.

competency_questions.question: Can event clocks leak the answer?
competency_questions.answer_rule: Assess target distinction and observation grid/channel with the clock regime audit; do not infer a regime from time embeddings alone.
competency_questions.missing_answer_policy: Return unresolved with evidence gaps, never a fabricated negative.

competency_questions.question: What changed between model or paper versions?
competency_questions.answer_rule: Compare version-qualified assertions and source hashes; never merge incompatible versions into a synthetic best system.
competency_questions.missing_answer_policy: Return unresolved with evidence gaps, never a fabricated negative.

ordered_steps: Pin source and model versions; create separate study, cohort, evaluation and implementation entities.
Import legacy cells as provisional historical extraction assertions with provenance. Re-read primary methods/results before promoting facts.
Annotate each relevant feature with the eight-state assessment, evidence stage, source locator, scope and test outcome.
Assign world types and membership axes; assess capability and readiness separately for each evaluated configuration.
Select relevant archetypes, blueprint profile and specialty overlays; record alternatives and selection rationale.
Instantiate M1–M10 responsibilities only where applicable; identify actual implementations, interface contracts and missing responsibilities.
Instantiate applicable gates with context-specific metrics and predeclared tolerances; mark pass/fail/unresolved/not_applicable with evidence.
Compare candidate components for contract compatibility and lineage; avoid double-counting shared evidence.
Emit a proposed composition with a module/contract diagram, design decisions, evidence matrix, unresolved gaps and validation plan.
Evaluate the new composition in its intended context; component evidence does not automatically validate the integrated blueprint.
blueprint_derivation.aggregation_policy: Use comparable study-level evidence with explicit dependence and heterogeneity; do not average ordinal capability/readiness or treat counts/graph centrality as a safety score.
blueprint_derivation.release_policy: A blueprint is a research design proposal. No ontology label, capability level or gate checklist independently grants clinical authorization.

membership_and_capability.unit: Classify a model version/evaluation context first; aggregate to paper only with an explicit many-model summary.

healthcare_scope.present_when: The modeled entity, target population, task or intended use is healthcare/biomedical.
healthcare_scope.absent_when: The documented task is outside healthcare; a generic reusable method may still be a supporting component.

core_method_under_legacy_schema.additional_condition: Healthcare scope; learned/hybrid transition acts on the modeled health/clinical/procedural world. Record the transition coordinate explicitly.

supporting_component.present_when: An evaluated/specified reusable encoder, uncertainty estimator, causal estimator, infrastructure, audit or safety component informs a WM responsibility without satisfying all core-method conditions.
supporting_component.not_required: The supporting paper need not itself implement a WM or be healthcare-specific if reuse rationale is explicit.

mechanistic_simulator.present_when: Explicit fixed/estimated physical/physiological equations evolve a defined state.
mechanistic_simulator.scope_note: Can fit the ontology even if it fails the legacy learned/hybrid core inclusion rule. Record estimated parameters versus learned transition structure separately.

survey_or_concept.present_when: The source synthesizes/proposes architecture rather than reporting its own operative model evaluation.
survey_or_concept.not_inferred: Do not inherit capability/readiness from cited systems.

excluded_or_pending.present_when: The paper is irrelevant, a documented duplicate, non-research, or cannot yet be assessed; retain the record and reason.
excluded_or_pending.not_inferred: Exclusion from this review is not proof the method has no value.

levels.name: Representation evaluated only
levels.consider_when: A learned state/representation is evaluated by probes, transfer, reconstruction or diagnosis, but no future-state/action-conditioned prediction result supports L1 or higher.
levels.do_not_assign_when: Only a conceptual discussion or unrelated static classifier exists, or a future-state result supports a higher level.
levels.additional_requirement: Representation-quality evaluation with the model’s WM-inspired state objective; not all static classifiers are L0.

levels.name: Temporal/successor-state prediction
levels.consider_when: Reported results evaluate prediction of later state/observation under observed/fixed/marginalized care or a declared successor coordinate.
levels.do_not_assign_when: Only a future-prediction training loss or static probe results are reported.

levels.name: Specified-action prediction
levels.consider_when: Reported future/successor prediction results are explicitly conditioned on specified, settable actions.
levels.do_not_assign_when: Actions only appear as generated outcome tokens, labels, uncontrolled covariates or untested conditioning claims.

levels.name: Matched alternative-action comparison
levels.consider_when: Reported results compare at least two specified action/regime predictions from the same initial patient/scene/history. One-step comparisons are allowed; record horizon and comparison type.
levels.do_not_assign_when: Only one factual regimen, unmatched subjects, immutable-covariate edits or an unevaluated comparison claim is shown.

levels.name: Model-coupled optimization/policy control
levels.consider_when: An implemented optimizer or learned decision policy uses the WM and has reported decision/control results. Includes offline/simulated policy learning with scope disclosed.
levels.do_not_assign_when: Only future generation, action-label prediction, bounded diagnostic candidate comparison without an optimizer/policy, or proposed planning is shown.

levels.name: No demonstrated world-model capability
levels.consider_when: The evaluated method lacks relevant evolving-state/successor prediction or WM-inspired representation evidence; surveys/concepts do not inherit cited capabilities.
levels.do_not_assign_when: Assessment is incomplete or the only reason is missing text; use not_assessed/unknown.

membership_and_capability.selection: Select the highest specifically supported functional label, retain each evaluated feature/horizon separately, and retain author-claimed levels as separate Claim assertions. L4 does not certify that every lower-level test was reported.
one_step_vs_trajectory_comparison: policy-level comparison with matched initial-state distribution
special_cases: Acquisition/view/pose transitions must be labeled as such; never rebrand them as disease-time or treatment-effect dynamics.
Block-generated future video can establish future prediction while recursive free-running rollout remains absent or not_applicable.
Reconstruction/denoising algorithm time does not establish time evolution of the modeled health world.
A state-transition method may be included as core while only representation/downstream results are demonstrated; report this evidence mismatch instead of silently promoting capability.

If bounded candidate ranking explicitly implements an optimizer/policy and measures decision performance, evaluate L4 criteria; otherwise retain L3. The decision protocol, not its marketing label, resolves the boundary.

legacy_import_policy.purpose: Keep the 109 legacy core world models recognised as world models during migration, without promoting legacy cells to verified facts.
legacy_import_policy.provisional_membership: Legacy 'Include – core' (column L) creates a provisional core-WM membership assertion (assertion_basis=legacy_extraction, evidence_stage=claim_or_specification as recorded). It is replaced only by a primary-source annotation that applies core_method_under_legacy_schema.
legacy_import_policy.strict_import_risk: Applying the core rule mechanically to the original legacy columns (AB, AC, BJ/BV) resolved only 81/109 legacy core papers; 33 fell to unresolved, mainly because BJ backbone is 'Other'/'Not reported' (e.g. B066, B063, B072, B049, B051, B105). Unresolved must not be read as 'not a world model'.
resolution_order: AB and AC positive (Yes/Partial) for persistent state and temporal transition
learned/hybrid via BJ learned backbone, BV reported objective, or Y learned paradigm / estimated mechanistic parameters
otherwise keep provisional legacy membership and queue primary-source verification

primary_source_spot_check.method: PDF text inspection of the rule-unresolved papers whose legacy columns gave no learned/state evidence
primary_source_spot_check.note: B049/B051/B105 TD-MPC2 learned latent dynamics; B045 Cardiac Dreamer; B037 surgical video world model; B088 surrogate trained on patient-specific multiphysics simulations; B086 physiology-informed model trained on clinical data; 088 hybrid mechanistic-learned. B037 legacy state/transition cells are 'Not reported' and should be refilled.

legacy_noncore_passing_core_rule.policy: Keep legacy label. 019 fails healthcare scope; 027 legacy capability 'Not a world model'; B012 (radiologist-reading model, WT_EXPERT), B046 (bundle audit) and A13 (Causal Transformer) remain supporting components unless primary-source annotation establishes a learned transition over a health-world coordinate with WM use.

world_model_identity.necessary_conditions: A record is a healthcare world model only if, at implementation stage or higher, a persistent state (state.persistent) is advanced by a learned or hybrid transition (dynamics.temporal + dynamics.learned_hybrid) over a declared health-world coordinate (time, event index, procedure step, acquisition pose), in healthcare scope.

identity_tiers.when: core rule met but only L0 evidence
L1: future state under observed/marginalised care
L2-L3: transition consumes settable actions; alternatives compared

non_dilution_invariants: Components, surveys, fixed mechanistic simulators, static predictors and excluded records stay in the registry but are never counted as world models.
Blueprint profiles other than BP_COMPONENT require core world-model membership (provisional or verified).
Labels such as 'world model' or 'digital twin' never establish membership; legacy self-labels span L0-L4.
Acquisition/view transitions are world-model transitions of WT_ACQUISITION, not disease or treatment dynamics.

facets.name: Concept/position
facets.consider_present_when: A framework/position is proposed without an implemented empirical system for the scoped claim.
facets.do_not_consider_present_when: Do not apply R0 to all reviews merely because their cited systems are immature.
facets.absent_rule: Explicit non-performance/nonexistence in the same scope; otherwise unresolved.

facets.name: Technical/simulation feasibility
facets.consider_present_when: A method is tested on synthetic data, a simulator, phantom, ex-vivo or other preclinical bench environment; record the exact environment.
facets.do_not_consider_present_when: Real robot hardware on a phantom is not a patient feasibility study.
facets.absent_rule: Explicit non-performance/nonexistence in the same scope; otherwise unresolved.

facets.name: Retrospective internal validation
facets.consider_present_when: A model is evaluated on held-out retrospective data within its development cohort/data domain using a stated split.
facets.do_not_consider_present_when: A training score or reused test set is not held-out validation.
facets.absent_rule: Explicit non-performance/nonexistence in the same scope; otherwise unresolved.

facets.name: External/multi-site validation
facets.consider_present_when: Evaluation includes a sufficiently independent cohort/site/time/population with the adaptation/refitting protocol and overlap controls declared.
facets.do_not_consider_present_when: Many hospitals in a pooled random split or a dataset brand alone do not prove independent external validation.
facets.absent_rule: Explicit non-performance/nonexistence in the same scope; otherwise unresolved.

facets.name: Human/expert evaluation
facets.consider_present_when: Actual clinicians/experts/users perform a defined reader/plausibility/use task and results are reported.
facets.do_not_consider_present_when: Simulated expert feedback, an LLM judge and anticipated clinical benefit do not qualify.
facets.absent_rule: Explicit non-performance/nonexistence in the same scope; otherwise unresolved.

facets.name: Prospective silent/shadow use
facets.consider_present_when: The pinned system runs prospectively on incoming workflow data while outputs do not affect care/physical action, with a reported protocol and outcomes.
facets.do_not_consider_present_when: Prospectively collected historical data analyzed offline are not shadow deployment.
facets.absent_rule: Explicit non-performance/nonexistence in the same scope; otherwise unresolved.

facets.name: Prospective interventional/feasibility
facets.consider_present_when: The scoped system prospectively informs/intervenes in actual human workflow/procedure under a documented feasibility protocol; distinguish healthy volunteers from patients.
facets.do_not_consider_present_when: Phantom/animal/ex-vivo execution or an offline plan recomputed on past scans alone does not qualify.
facets.absent_rule: Explicit non-performance/nonexistence in the same scope; otherwise unresolved.

facets.name: Comparative effectiveness
facets.consider_present_when: A prospective randomized or otherwise appropriately designed comparative effectiveness study measures outcomes/harms for actual system use; record allocation/design and causal limitations.
facets.do_not_consider_present_when: Published trials used only as a simulation benchmark, retrospective OPE or simulated treatment returns do not qualify.
facets.absent_rule: Explicit non-performance/nonexistence in the same scope; otherwise unresolved.

facets.name: Authorized use and post-release monitoring
facets.consider_present_when: The specified product/version/intended use has documented relevant authorization/acceptance and operational lifecycle monitoring in the applicable jurisdiction.
facets.do_not_consider_present_when: A named standard, research-simulator acceptance in another use, ethics approval or product announcement alone does not qualify.
facets.absent_rule: Explicit non-performance/nonexistence in the same scope; otherwise unresolved.

readiness_model.representation: Store every supported facet per model/system, component, population, environment and endpoint; facets are not logically cumulative.
readiness_model.legacy_summary: Highest reported R label can be retained for backward-compatible display, alongside the facet vector and scope; it is not an interval-scale quality score.
readiness_model.engineering_readiness: MLTRL is separate from R0–R8 and from clinical authorization; store its named framework/version and evidence.
readiness_model.clinical_benefit: R4 expert preference, R6 feasibility and R7 comparative patient/workflow utility are different outcomes. No stage transfers automatically from one component to the composition.

directed_channels.role: native timing/availability and direct explicit-state input
encoded evidence; assimilate via specified update
outcomes/utilities; causal interpretation only if justified

blueprint_topology.execution_feedback: Only an authorized external action changes the actual environment. New measured observations re-enter M1/M2/M3; imagined states are not relabeled as factual observations.
blueprint_topology.not_a_linear_chain: M9/M10 are cross-cutting; no claim that passing one module makes all later outputs safe.
composition_invariants: Revalidate the coupled composition rather than multiplying independent-looking module success rates

blueprint_profiles.name: Representation, component, audit or data-resource contribution
blueprint_profiles.applicable_when: The paper supplies a reusable part or assessment rather than a complete temporal simulator.
conditional_additions: Select only actually relevant module responsibilities.
Require a task-specific component/resource evaluation for effectiveness claims.
Do not require G02 or a planner to retain a useful supporting component.
G01 may be not_applicable for a purely conceptual review with a documented reason.
blueprint_profiles.selection_rule: Separate implements, evaluates, audits and recommends relations.
blueprint_profiles.not_when: Do not call a recommendation or static benchmark a complete patient world model.

blueprint_profiles.name: Temporal prediction research
blueprint_profiles.applicable_when: Any appropriate world type; no action selection or causal effect claim.
blueprint_profiles.selection_rule: Intersect with the selected WorldType, intended use and claimed output; applicability may remove a gate with explicit reason, never silently.
blueprint_profiles.not_when: Do not force a representation-only component into a clinical deployment stack or declare a complete deployment because it supplies one module.

blueprint_profiles.name: Long-horizon probabilistic forecasting
blueprint_profiles.applicable_when: Multistep or multi-time outputs with uncertainty claims.
blueprint_profiles.selection_rule: Intersect with the selected WorldType, intended use and claimed output; applicability may remove a gate with explicit reason, never silently.
blueprint_profiles.not_when: Do not force a representation-only component into a clinical deployment stack or declare a complete deployment because it supplies one module.

blueprint_profiles.name: Associational alternative-action exploration
blueprint_profiles.applicable_when: Action comparisons are explicitly exploratory and not presented as identified treatment effects.
conditional_additions: G03 only for more than one prediction time
G04 when uncertainty guarantees are claimed
blueprint_profiles.selection_rule: Intersect with the selected WorldType, intended use and claimed output; applicability may remove a gate with explicit reason, never silently.
blueprint_profiles.not_when: Do not force a representation-only component into a clinical deployment stack or declare a complete deployment because it supplies one module.

blueprint_profiles.name: Causal intervention-effect research
blueprint_profiles.applicable_when: A defined intervention-effect estimand is claimed.
blueprint_profiles.selection_rule: Intersect with the selected WorldType, intended use and claimed output; applicability may remove a gate with explicit reason, never silently.
blueprint_profiles.not_when: Do not force a representation-only component into a clinical deployment stack or declare a complete deployment because it supplies one module.

blueprint_profiles.name: Model-coupled policy/control research
blueprint_profiles.applicable_when: Optimization/policy uses predictive dynamics in a simulator or physical environment.
blueprint_profiles.selection_rule: Intersect with the selected WorldType, intended use and claimed output; applicability may remove a gate with explicit reason, never silently.
blueprint_profiles.not_when: Do not force a representation-only component into a clinical deployment stack or declare a complete deployment because it supplies one module.

blueprint_profiles.name: Clinical decision-support deployment candidate
blueprint_profiles.applicable_when: Human users consider model advice within a defined clinical workflow.
conditional_additions: G11 before claiming realized clinical/workflow utility
blueprint_profiles.selection_rule: Intersect with the selected WorldType, intended use and claimed output; applicability may remove a gate with explicit reason, never silently.
blueprint_profiles.not_when: Do not force a representation-only component into a clinical deployment stack or declare a complete deployment because it supplies one module.

blueprint_profiles.name: Operational/physical automation candidate
blueprint_profiles.applicable_when: Actions can change actual environment/care under defined authorization.
conditional_additions: Authorization and physical hazard assessment outside ontology
blueprint_profiles.selection_rule: Intersect with the selected WorldType, intended use and claimed output; applicability may remove a gate with explicit reason, never silently.
blueprint_profiles.not_when: Do not force a representation-only component into a clinical deployment stack or declare a complete deployment because it supplies one module.

architecture_archetypes.name: Event-token simulator
architecture_archetypes.consider_when: A generative event/time model advances patient history and predicts subsequent events.
architecture_archetypes.not_when: Only static diagnostic code classification occurs.

architecture_archetypes.name: Latent trajectory model
architecture_archetypes.consider_when: Transitions operate on a retained latent state; optional observations/readouts are decoded.
architecture_archetypes.not_when: A latent encoder is used only for static downstream classification.

architecture_archetypes.name: Generative observation/scene simulator
architecture_archetypes.consider_when: Conditional future observations/scene states are generated at specified successor times or action coordinates.
architecture_archetypes.not_when: Only static unconstrained augmentation/reconstruction is performed.

architecture_archetypes.name: Mechanistic or hybrid dynamics
architecture_archetypes.consider_when: Explicit physiology/physics and fitted/learned quantities govern state evolution.
architecture_archetypes.not_when: A physics word appears in discussion without operational coupling.

architecture_archetypes.name: Model-coupled controller
architecture_archetypes.consider_when: A state/action dynamics model feeds online search or policy learning/inference with evaluated control.
architecture_archetypes.not_when: Only a policy imitation loss or future-video quality is shown.

specialty_profiles.name: ICU / respiratory / sepsis
specialty_profiles.special_note: Use native timing, dose/route/schedule and organ-support context; the ontology supplies no dose or clinical target defaults.

specialty_profiles.name: Oncology longitudinal imaging / regimens
specialty_profiles.special_note: Separate predicted morphology, response/survival readouts and identified treatment effects; censoring and competing events must be explicit.

specialty_profiles.name: Surgery / endoscopy / endovascular
specialty_profiles.special_note: Frame conventions, tool/tissue contacts, physical environment and control deadline must be declared. Phantom success is not patient effectiveness.

specialty_profiles.name: Ultrasound / acquisition / registration
specialty_profiles.special_note: Distinguish view geometry, physical probe contact and patient disease dynamics; healthy-volunteer feasibility is scoped accordingly.

specialty_profiles.name: Pharmacology and precision dosing
specialty_profiles.special_note: Retain concentration/exposure units, individual fitting and alternative-regimen uncertainty; mechanism fit does not guarantee causal validity for every patient.

specialty_profiles.name: Neurology / ophthalmology / progression imaging
specialty_profiles.special_note: Do not confuse spatial interpolation, normal aging or population-average reconstruction with patient-specific temporal progression.

specialty_profiles.name: Wearables / rehabilitation / behavioral coaching
specialty_profiles.special_note: Wear time, device/placement and adherence affect observations; preferred coaching plans do not establish realized adherence/health benefit.

specialty_profiles.name: Public health and health-system operations
specialty_profiles.special_note: Population-policy effects and patient-care effects are distinct estimands; resource policies require queue/resource constraints and interference assumptions.

action_ontology.classification_rule: Role comes from intended operation, channel from modeled/physical effects, representation from encoding and authority from actual permissions. Allow multiple roles/channels with justification.
action_ontology.latent_actions: Record an ungrounded latent action as such; do not attach drug-dose or robot-control meaning until alignment is demonstrated.
action_ontology.non_actions: Age, disease labels and post-treatment observations are state/covariates unless a legitimate explicitly modeled intervention target is defined; model editing is not automatically clinical action.
action_ontology.support_contract: Availability and clinical validity are distinct: empirically common actions can be contraindicated; clinically feasible actions can lack statistical support.
action_ontology.bundle_contract: Specify full replacement versus partial update, unchanged inherited parameters, concurrent treatments and valid combinations; no universal list of mandatory ventilator parameters is supplied.

observation_clock_regimes.scope: A specific target distinction, stream/channel set and grid resolution; not a global immutable dataset label.

values.name: Value-witnessed / clock-safe
values.consider_when: The fixed-grid values retain evidence distinguishing the defined target histories.
values.required_retention: Grid resampling is supported only for this tested target/resolution.

values.name: Cell-witnessed
values.consider_when: Grid values alone fail, but update counts/occupancy/validity/reject patterns distinguish the target.
values.required_retention: Retain the relevant cell-level update/validity summaries alongside values.

values.name: External-witness-only

values.name: Unresolved
values.consider_when: Evidence establishes none of the four regimes for this target/channel/grid scope.

annotation_record_schema.title: Qualified healthcare world-model annotation record
annotation_record_schema.description: Structural validation only. Cross-reference, evidence entailment, temporal/dependency scope and capability/gate rules below require a semantic validator/reviewer.

semantic_constraints.rule: Every assertion/evidence ID is unique and all referenced IDs resolve within the annotation or its declared registry.
semantic_constraints.enforcement: Requires a scope-aware semantic checker/reviewer; JSON Schema alone cannot prove the scientific statement.

semantic_constraints.rule: Empirical feature assertions attach to a specific model/module/evaluation/use scope, not automatically every system reported by a paper.
semantic_constraints.enforcement: Requires a scope-aware semantic checker/reviewer; JSON Schema alone cannot prove the scientific statement.

semantic_constraints.rule: Present/absent/partial assertions cite evidence; absent additionally requires explicit negative or documented incompatible-method rationale.
semantic_constraints.enforcement: Requires a scope-aware semantic checker/reviewer; JSON Schema alone cannot prove the scientific statement.

semantic_constraints.rule: A claim/specification or occurrence-only quotation cannot satisfy an implementation/evaluation gate.
semantic_constraints.enforcement: Requires a scope-aware semantic checker/reviewer; JSON Schema alone cannot prove the scientific statement.

semantic_constraints.rule: A reviewed gate pass uses entailment-reviewed supporting evidence in compatible model/version/context scope.
semantic_constraints.enforcement: Requires a scope-aware semantic checker/reviewer; JSON Schema alone cannot prove the scientific statement.

semantic_constraints.rule: Not reported, not assessed, unknown and unresolved legacy values are not cast to false, zero, absent or gate fail.
semantic_constraints.enforcement: Requires a scope-aware semantic checker/reviewer; JSON Schema alone cannot prove the scientific statement.

semantic_constraints.rule: Not applicable has a dependency/use-context reason; absent parent implementation and unreported parent are not conflated.
semantic_constraints.enforcement: Requires a scope-aware semantic checker/reviewer; JSON Schema alone cannot prove the scientific statement.

semantic_constraints.rule: A partial assessment identifies both criteria met and criteria missing.
semantic_constraints.enforcement: Requires a scope-aware semantic checker/reviewer; JSON Schema alone cannot prove the scientific statement.

semantic_constraints.rule: Compatible-scope contradictory evidence is preserved as conflicting or as qualified rival assertions, not overwritten.
semantic_constraints.enforcement: Requires a scope-aware semantic checker/reviewer; JSON Schema alone cannot prove the scientific statement.

semantic_constraints.rule: Implemented module and reviewer informs/recommends relations are different predicates.
semantic_constraints.enforcement: Requires a scope-aware semantic checker/reviewer; JSON Schema alone cannot prove the scientific statement.

semantic_constraints.rule: Core-method status requires healthcare context and implemented state plus learned/hybrid transition; it is not inferred from name.
semantic_constraints.enforcement: Requires a scope-aware semantic checker/reviewer; JSON Schema alone cannot prove the scientific statement.

semantic_constraints.rule: L1 requires reported future/successor prediction evaluation; static probe quality or future-target loss alone is insufficient.
semantic_constraints.enforcement: Requires a scope-aware semantic checker/reviewer; JSON Schema alone cannot prove the scientific statement.

semantic_constraints.rule: L2 requires specified-action future prediction evidence, not just medication tokens or covariance.
semantic_constraints.enforcement: Requires a scope-aware semantic checker/reviewer; JSON Schema alone cannot prove the scientific statement.

semantic_constraints.rule: L3 requires at least two action alternatives with matching initial patient/scene/history; it may be one-step and need not be causally identified.
semantic_constraints.enforcement: Requires a scope-aware semantic checker/reviewer; JSON Schema alone cannot prove the scientific statement.

semantic_constraints.rule: L4 requires operational model-coupled optimization/policy and decision/control results; explicit L3 comparison tests are not automatically inherited.
semantic_constraints.enforcement: Requires a scope-aware semantic checker/reviewer; JSON Schema alone cannot prove the scientific statement.

semantic_constraints.rule: Causal-effect interpretation requires a scoped estimand/identification or justified mechanism, assumptions, support and appropriate validation; L3/L4 alone do not suffice.
semantic_constraints.enforcement: Requires a scope-aware semantic checker/reviewer; JSON Schema alone cannot prove the scientific statement.

semantic_constraints.rule: R4 needs actual human review/use evidence; automated clinician-feedback labels alone cannot satisfy it.
semantic_constraints.enforcement: Requires a scope-aware semantic checker/reviewer; JSON Schema alone cannot prove the scientific statement.

semantic_constraints.rule: R5 requires prospective silent use of the actual system; prospective data collection alone cannot satisfy it.
semantic_constraints.enforcement: Requires a scope-aware semantic checker/reviewer; JSON Schema alone cannot prove the scientific statement.

semantic_constraints.rule: R6 cannot be derived solely from in-silico, phantom, ex-vivo or animal control. Healthy-volunteer evidence cannot be silently generalized to patient therapy.
semantic_constraints.enforcement: Requires a scope-aware semantic checker/reviewer; JSON Schema alone cannot prove the scientific statement.

semantic_constraints.rule: R7 cannot be derived from simulating outcomes from published RCTs or retrospective/off-policy estimates.
semantic_constraints.enforcement: Requires a scope-aware semantic checker/reviewer; JSON Schema alone cannot prove the scientific statement.

semantic_constraints.rule: R8 is product/version/use/jurisdiction specific and requires authorization plus monitoring evidence; ethics approval is not equivalent.
semantic_constraints.enforcement: Requires a scope-aware semantic checker/reviewer; JSON Schema alone cannot prove the scientific statement.

semantic_constraints.rule: Maximum generated/tested horizon, effective validated horizon, planning horizon, execution horizon and memory context are separate quantities.
semantic_constraints.enforcement: Requires a scope-aware semantic checker/reviewer; JSON Schema alone cannot prove the scientific statement.

semantic_constraints.rule: Effective horizon needs a metric/tolerance, evaluation curve, support/population and model version; an arbitrary clamp is not validation.
semantic_constraints.enforcement: Requires a scope-aware semantic checker/reviewer; JSON Schema alone cannot prove the scientific statement.

semantic_constraints.rule: Teacher-forced, block-generated, recursive free-running and measured re-assimilation results retain their protocols.
semantic_constraints.enforcement: Requires a scope-aware semantic checker/reviewer; JSON Schema alone cannot prove the scientific statement.

semantic_constraints.rule: Uncertainty existence, decomposition, calibration performed and tolerance achieved are independent assertions.
semantic_constraints.enforcement: Requires a scope-aware semantic checker/reviewer; JSON Schema alone cannot prove the scientific statement.

semantic_constraints.rule: Failed calibration can make calibration-evaluation present with test_outcome=fail; it does not imply the evaluation was absent.
semantic_constraints.enforcement: Requires a scope-aware semantic checker/reviewer; JSON Schema alone cannot prove the scientific statement.

semantic_constraints.rule: Regulatory mention, applicability, reporting compliance, ethics approval and authorization are not interchangeable.
semantic_constraints.enforcement: Requires a scope-aware semantic checker/reviewer; JSON Schema alone cannot prove the scientific statement.

semantic_constraints.rule: Shared dataset/model lineage and graph connectedness are not certificates of independent studies or exact duplicates.
semantic_constraints.enforcement: Requires a scope-aware semantic checker/reviewer; JSON Schema alone cannot prove the scientific statement.

semantic_constraints.rule: Numerical performance has metric/units/task/horizon/dataset/split/baseline and uncertainty context; percent gains from heterogeneous tasks are not pooled.
semantic_constraints.enforcement: Requires a scope-aware semantic checker/reviewer; JSON Schema alone cannot prove the scientific statement.

semantic_constraints.rule: An observed failure, a potential hazard, a mitigation and evaluated mitigation effectiveness are separately typed.
semantic_constraints.enforcement: Requires a scope-aware semantic checker/reviewer; JSON Schema alone cannot prove the scientific statement.

semantic_constraints.rule: A high L label with action-conditioned or temporal flags coded No triggers a scope/evidence review rather than an automatic overwrite.
semantic_constraints.enforcement: Requires a scope-aware semantic checker/reviewer; JSON Schema alone cannot prove the scientific statement.

semantic_constraints.rule: A core method with L0/not_world_model capability can reflect unvalidated proposed dynamics; preserve the method/result distinction.
semantic_constraints.enforcement: Requires a scope-aware semantic checker/reviewer; JSON Schema alone cannot prove the scientific statement.

semantic_constraints.rule: Graph hubs, common methods, summed reviewer scores and nonsignificant p-values cannot justify universal design or independence claims.
semantic_constraints.enforcement: Requires a scope-aware semantic checker/reviewer; JSON Schema alone cannot prove the scientific statement.

semantic_constraints.rule: A shared API needs state, unit, time, support and uncertainty compatibility plus new composition-level validation.
semantic_constraints.enforcement: Requires a scope-aware semantic checker/reviewer; JSON Schema alone cannot prove the scientific statement.

semantic_constraints.rule: Notebook hard-coded reliability curves, hand-written demo dynamics/propensities and unconditional personalization flags are illustrative, not primary experimental evidence.
semantic_constraints.enforcement: Requires a scope-aware semantic checker/reviewer; JSON Schema alone cannot prove the scientific statement.

semantic_constraints.rule: A static/no-action research component may fit BP_COMPONENT with action/planner features not_applicable; do not force a clinical control stack onto it.
semantic_constraints.enforcement: Requires a scope-aware semantic checker/reviewer; JSON Schema alone cannot prove the scientific statement.

classification_edge_cases.case: Matched one-step alternative-action predictions without identified treatment effects
classification_edge_cases.classify_as: Functional L3 when the comparison is demonstrated; causal validity separately unresolved/unsupported.

classification_edge_cases.case: Action-conditioned imagined control on a physical phantom
classification_edge_cases.classify_as: L4 may apply; phantom environment, not R6 patient feasibility.

classification_edge_cases.case: Learned future latent prediction objective with only representation probes
classification_edge_cases.classify_as: Specify predictive dynamics mechanism; demonstrated capability may remain L0.

classification_edge_cases.case: Point-state recurrent estimator without a distribution
classification_edge_cases.classify_as: State/memory may be present; posterior uncertainty and calibration not established.

classification_edge_cases.case: Maximum generated rollout is 12 hours; no error-versus-horizon evaluation
classification_edge_cases.classify_as: Requested/generated horizon 12h; defensible effective horizon unresolved.

classification_edge_cases.case: A recommended JEPA planner appears only in a review table
classification_edge_cases.classify_as: Recommendation/specification; not an implemented or evaluated module.

classification_edge_cases.case: A stochastic simulator explicitly fails a coverage test
classification_edge_cases.classify_as: Stochasticity present; calibration evaluated present with test_outcome fail; not calibrated.

annotation_model_notes.entities: Declare versioned nodes using classes; domain-specific properties must follow the relevant interface contract or class definition. These properties remain extensible.
annotation_model_notes.relations: Use relation_assertions with subject_id, predicate_id and object_id; check domain/range against entity classes and all evidence qualifiers.
annotation_model_notes.features: Use assertions for feature assessments. They are not unqualified boolean edges.
annotation_model_notes.scope: Keep source versions, model versions, cohorts, environment and evaluation scope explicit; do not collapse incompatible observations.

refinements: Q='Procedure / scene (surgery, acquisition)' and BB='Acquisition / probe motion' -> primary WT_ACQUISITION (9 legacy core papers).
Q='Tissue / organ' and BB='Acquisition / probe motion' -> WT_ORGAN primary plus WT_ACQUISITION secondary (3 legacy core papers); world types are non-exclusive.
Q='Multi-scale' -> WT_MULTISCALE only when two component world types and their coupling are named; otherwise unresolved.
Q='Not reported' -> world type unresolved; do not infer from domain.
